title: #smallpoems let loose moorings of a crescent moon while our heavenly wolf howls Through words spilled, we seek, yet never find, a path of souls Inanna
summary: #smallpoems let loose moorings of a crescent moon while our heavenly wolf howls Through words spilled, we seek, yet never find, a path of souls Inanna, Venus, Ishtar, Aphrodite, bits loosely joined in stories that never begin in poems with no end
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
let loose moorings
of a crescent
moon while
our heavenly wolf
howls
Through words
spilled,
we seek, yet never find,
a path of souls
Inanna, Venus, Ishtar, Aphrodite,
bits loosely joined in
stories that never begin in
poems with no end
